retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy rock aesthetic featuring chrome-beveled typography emerging from a scorched, burning paper cutout against a textured yellow background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central jagged, scorched-edge paper cutout reveals a metallic, chrome-beveled monogram, surrounded by realistic flames and smoke on a textured ochre background.
coreVisualRelationships: Chrome monogram centered within a dark scorched void
Realistic flames licking the edges of the central cutout
Secondary text angled along the diagonal corners
High-contrast transition from yellow background to dark burnt interior
coreInvariants: Metallic chrome beveling with purple/silver gradients

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central monogram occupies the middle 60% of the frame, framed by a jagged burnt hole.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-shine chrome monogram with its sharp geometric angles.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central chrome logo, move outward to the flames, then follow the diagonal text in the top-left and bottom-right corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The textured yellow background acts as the primary negative space, providing a high-contrast field for the dark burnt hole.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Ochre yellow background providing a warm, aged texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown and black scorched edges defining the central shape.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Silver and violet gradients within the chrome lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright yellow background and the deep, dark interior of the burn.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy 3D beveling with internal light reflections
Secondary text uses a condensed, heavy sans-serif with a slight italic slant
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the monogram are fused together to create a singular graphic unit
Terminals are cut at sharp 45-degree angles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A complex, illustrative central monogram paired with a clean, condensed functional sans-serif for readability.

avoid: Drop shadows on the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and density of the secondary text.
Required for the central monogram's 3D effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a textured ochre-yellow background with a large, jagged, scorched-edge hole in the center. Inside the hole, the color should be dark brown to black. Add realistic flames and smoke wisps licking the edges of the hole.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a custom-lettered chrome monogram with purple-silver gradients and heavy beveling inside the central hole. Add condensed bold sans-serif text in black, angled diagonally in the top-left and bottom-right corners.

verificationChecks: Is the central monogram chrome and beveled?
Are the paper edges jagged and scorched?
Is the secondary text angled diagonally?
Is the background a textured yellow?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the chrome has a purple/violet tint in the shadows.
Verify the flames appear to be coming from behind the paper.
Check that the corner text is perfectly aligned to a diagonal axis.
Confirm the background texture is visible and not a flat color.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central [Metallic Monogram] + [Scorched Paper Cutout] + [Realistic Flames] + [Diagonal Condensed Text] + [Textured Yellow Field]
